notes: Rejected on two grounds. The full-size front view shows a clearly legible ARINA manufacturer wordmark on the control panel, and CC0 does not waive trademark rights, so we cannot promise clean as-is resale. Separately, the rear orbits and back view show an unfinished open cavity with no back panel, which fails the completeness bar for a library asset. Modelling of the front is otherwise good.
limitations: Legible ARINA manufacturer badge; CC0 does not grant trademark rights.
Rear of the appliance is an open unfinished cavity with no back panel.
